prompt:
I want to build a peer-to-peer marketplace where people can lend and borrow physical items (tools, camping gear, etc.) from their neighbours. Core features:

- Users list items with photos, availability calendar, and a daily rental price
- Borrowers search by location and category, request to rent
- Lenders approve/decline requests
- Payment handled by Stripe (we never touch card data directly)
- Both parties rate each other after a transaction
- Users can message each other within the app
- Profile page shows public rating, listed items, and member since date

I'm a solo developer building an MVP, so I want to focus on the most important security and privacy stuff first without getting overwhelmed. Keep the analysis focused on the highest-priority risks.
